trendSpec.sessions: DAY+NIGHT continuous within one contract; indicators reset at contract change
trendSpec.entry: close beyond prior 20-bar Donchian high/low -> enter next bar open in breakout direction; one position at a time
trendSpec.trailing: long: max(stop, highest high since entry - 3*ATR) updated at each bar close; short mirrored
trendSpec.exits: gap through stop fills at bar open; else stop price; forced exit at last bar close before contract change
trendSpec.volFilter: skip entry when ATR14 is in the bottom third of its own prior 250 60m-bar values; no trades before 250 bars of history
trendSpec.control: same number of random entries (eligible bars, random direction), identical exits, 2000 draws; p = share of draws with mean net R >= observed

surgeSpec.rvol: bar volume / median volume of the same clock slot over the prior 20 sessions of the same type (DAY or NIGHT)
surgeSpec.direction: sign(close - open) of the surge bar; zero-body bars skipped
surgeSpec.outcome: signed move from surge-bar close to close 12 bars later (60m), in units of ATR14 (5m, rolled across previous session); events without 12 later bars in the session are excluded
surgeSpec.control: for each event, a random non-surge bar (RVOL<1.5) in the same session type, same hour bucket and same decile of |body|/ATR; 2000 draws
surgeSpec.primary: mean signed outcome of surge events minus matched controls, two-sided permutation p (continuation if >0, reversal if <0)
secondary: US cash open (first 15 min after 21:30 summer / 22:30 winter Taiwan time)
tradable check: enter next bar open in surge direction, 1.5 ATR stop, 60m time exit, net R

primaryTests: V4 trend: mean net R vs random-entry control, one-sided p<0.05
V5 surge: 60m signed move vs matched control, two-sided p<0.05
decisionRule: Holm over these 2. A trend candidate additionally needs mean net R>0 for TX costs and both halves (Jan-Apr, May-Aug) non-negative. A surge effect is information only; it becomes a strategy candidate only if the tradable check is also net positive.
